title: See what the agent's subagents are doing
done: That is it: the Trail opens at the turn that started the subagent.

steps.caption: Subagents lists each subagent the agent started, running or finished.
Each shows its task, its model, and when finished, its time, tokens and tool calls.
Click one to read its report.
Your turn: press Show in Trail to see where it was started.
